correctness.rationale: For y^5-y=x^4+x²+x over F5 the sole pole at infinity has order 4, so Riemann–Hurwitz gives genus six, Deuring–Shafarevich gives 5-rank zero, and there is exactly one rational point above infinity. Counting trace-zero values independently over F_(5^n), n=1..6, yields N=(6,6,156,646,3501,15576), matching package values; for n=2 N2=N1=6, hence no degree-two closed places. Newton power sums S=(0,20,-30,-20,-375,50), Newton identities and Weil functional equation yield full L=(1,0,-10,10,55,-25,-175,-125,1375,1250,-6250,0,15625). Reduction mod 2 is T^12+T^8+T^7+T^6+T^5+T^4+1; Rabin tests at 2^12, 2^6 and 2^4 certify irreducibility, so Frobenius char polynomial is irreducible and Jacobian is simple over F5. L(1)=11731 and trial division to sqrt(11731) proves this prime, hence J(F5) cyclic of prime order. Direct finite counts are enough for all coefficients only because genus six and functional equation, not by extrapolation; geometric simplicity is not asserted.
residual_risks: Finite independent tests corroborate only tested parameters; universal argument is from source proof and standard theorem applications.
